steps.label: Asks why the system allowed it

steps.label: Produces a more honest timeline
steps.sub: people speak up when admitting a mistake won't get them blamed

eyebrow: Five Whys — past the first, shallow answer
code:
1. Why did checkout fail?        -> A bad config value was deployed
2. Why was it deployed?          -> Validation didn't catch it
3. Why didn't validation catch it? -> It only checked syntax, not ranges
4. Why only syntax?              -> Range checks never added
5. Why never added?              -> No process flags schema changes
                                     for a validation review
caption: Lands on a fixable process gap, not an individual mistake.
